quote.text: If you are distressed by anything external, the pain is not due to the thing itself, but to your estimate of it; and this you have the power to revoke at any moment.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Remember that your interpretation of your child's behavior shapes your feelings—by adjusting your perspective, you can cultivate patience and understanding during challenging moments.
    • Recognize that external challenges in parenting can be met by choosing a calm response; this empowers you to teach resilience and empathy by example.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, be aware that your stress often arises from how you view external events rather than the events themselves; this insight can help you maintain clarity and composure.
    • By reframing challenges as opportunities for growth, you can inspire your team to adopt a proactive attitude and seek solutions rather than dwelling on obstacles.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, setbacks or feedback are inevitable; understanding that your reaction is within your control allows you to use criticism constructively rather than defensively.
    • Apply the principle that perception shapes reality by continuously re-evaluating risks and opportunities—this can help you pivot strategies effectively and foster innovation.
